title: Refine the Resolved Layers symbol
question: Which geometry should become the basis for the final vector logo? Color and application design remain outside this round.

options.label: A — Calibrated Original
options.lineage: the selected three-frame construction, optically corrected
options.thesis: Preserve the exact family and asymmetry that made Resolved Layers feel unique.
options.viewport: Three separated frames retain their original offsets with cleaner junctions and spacing.
options.risk: The icon remains slightly intricate at the smallest sizes and needs deterministic vector cleanup.

options.label: B — Essential Layers
options.lineage: the selected idea reduced to a compact two-level contour
options.thesis: Maximum simplicity makes the symbol easy to reproduce and recognize at small scale.
options.viewport: The layers compress into a simpler nested structure with fewer fragile gaps.
options.risk: It loses much of the three-layer character and starts to resemble a document or copy icon.

options.label: C — Evidence Cell
options.lineage: the selected frames organized around a deliberate central void
options.thesis: The shared negative-space cell becomes the symbol's signature evidence point.
options.viewport: Three entries point toward one crisp center while preserving the layered family.
options.risk: The angled front frame can read as a play button, box, or three-dimensional object.
